verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a cloud transcription API, but nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage or processing region. Batch mode can write transcripts next to input files in the caller's own S3 prefix. That is an adjacent output-location control, not a Zoom-provided region or residency choice, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
